coverage_notes: PartEdit unit test stores Slot::Set, Slot::Clear, and Slot::Inherit for glyph and size; repeated same-value glyph Set remains Slot::Set. Source confirms no equality-based inference: glyph/size store Slot directly and PartRecipe::merge_from applies Slot::over.

Runtime integration tests exercise glyph Inherit/Set/Clear through the public Theme::define_family closure and verify rendered marker and suffix cells. Both formerly direct-mutation fixtures now use typed declarations.

No public runtime consumer fixture exercises size_slot output. The existing metrics_is_the_sizing_path_for_update test covers size resolution but mutates the installed recipe directly. This is a follow-up coverage opportunity; the added size_slot implementation is a direct Slot assignment and is covered for all variants by the PartEdit unit test.

The public `glyph` and `size` builders retain signatures and Set behavior by delegation. This commit removes or deprecates no public API. Recipes::get_mut and iter_mut remain; stage 2 migration is still pending.
No review of raw mutation stage 2 or MenuBar precedence is implied. No frozen parity or application acceptance is implied.

source_review.PartEdit::glyph_slot: Directly assigns Slot<GlyphRole>; `glyph` delegates with Slot::Set.
source_review.PartEdit::size_slot: Directly assigns Slot<u16>; `size` delegates with Slot::Set.
source_review.RecipeEdit::into_parts: Clones PartEdit recipes without collapsing equal values.
source_review.Theme::define_family: Merges through PartRecipe::merge_from; Slot::Inherit leaves lower recipe value, Set replaces, Clear remains explicit.
source_review.facade: Both termrock-theme and termrock reexport Slot, GlyphRole, and Theme; external fixture compiles inferred RecipeEdit/PartEdit closure without naming either type.
